echoParts: for the LORD your God is with you
verseText: Have I not commanded you to be strong and courageous? Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.
meaning: Even when we face scary times, God tells us to be strong and courageous. We don't need to be scared because the Lord God has promised to be with us wherever we go.

recall.question: Why can Joshua be strong and courageous?

meaning.question: What can help us face scary situations?

application.prompt: Think of something that feels scary. Remind yourself, 'God is with me,' and ask Him for courage.
